Application Timeline
Note: The above timeline only shows the time frames of applications made through the Office of International Affairs. For applications through the University Entrance Committee for Overseas Chinese Students and the University Entrance Committee for Mainland Chinese Students, please refer to their respective websites.
International Student Applications are open in August (graduate programs only), Late September/Early October, and December each year. Overseas Chinese, Hong Kong & Macau Students Applications (NTU Admissions) are open every August to September. Check out their respective application webpages for full information and exact dates.

The Office of International Affairs is here to help! It is our responsibility to ensure that every international studentâs needs are met, and that you get the most out of your stay at NTU.
Drop-in consultation hours: Monday to Friday, 1:30 PM to 4:30 PM
National Taiwan University conducts its international student admissions in accordance with the regulations of the Ministry of Education. The University does not collaborate with any study abroad agencies or external institutions for recruitment purposes. Requests from such organizations for campus visits, meetings, or recruitment cooperation are, in principle, not accommodated.
All official admissions information is published on NTUâs Overseas Student Admission website. The campus remains open to the public; those who wish to explore are welcomed to visitâno prior application is required.
